text.config.crowmap-config.title: CrowMap
text.config.crowmap-config.option.mapUrl: URL of the Dynmap instance to load.
text.config.crowmap-config.option.useLoc: Hosts LiveAtlas locally and proxies all Dynmap requests through it, replacing the default Dynmap UI. Downloads ~150 KB on first use. Disable on low-end hardware.
text.config.crowmap-config.option.debugL: Log verbose diagnostic messages. Enable when troubleshooting browser or projection issues.
text.config.crowmap-config.option.liveAt: Render player icons above other map markers.
Show the search bar in the player list.
Use pre-2.0 style compact player markers.
Disable the right-click context menu on the map.
Hide the markers button and list entirely.
text.config.crowmap-config.option.hudEna: Show a live minimap in the corner of the screen.
text.config.crowmap-config.option.hudCor: Which corner of the screen the minimap appears in.
text.config.crowmap-config.option.hudSiz: Side length of the minimap in pixels.
text.config.crowmap-config.option.hudMar: Gap between the minimap and the screen edge in pixels.
text.config.crowmap-config.option.projec: Project the map as a flat panel in the world. Use the 'Place World Map' keybind to position it, and 'Toggle World Map' to show or hide it.
Width of the projected map panel in blocks. Height scales automatically to match the browser aspect ratio.
text.config.crowmap-config.option.anchor: Tie the world projection to a sign instead of a fixed position. Stand next to a matching sign and press 'Place World Map' to store the offset. The projection will follow the sign's position even after you move away.
Text that identifies the anchor sign. Matched against any line on the front or back of a sign.
text.config.crowmap-config.option.overla: Hold: overlay is visible while the key is held down. Toggle: press once to show, press again to hide.
Display size multiplier for the overlay image. 1.0 = fits the screen exactly.
